user.title: Add hass-agent media players
user.description: Automatically add a media player to each hass-agent MQTT device with Now Playing enabled. Uses your existing MQTT connection; no per-device setup. If there are no players yet, leave this integration enabled: players appear automatically when a Mac's hass-agent publishes Now Playing. Start hass-agent in the Mac's logged-in desktop session.

abort.already_configured: Hass Agent Media is already configured.
abort.mqtt_required: Set up the MQTT integration first, then add Hass Agent Media.
